# SH✡MER (SHOMER app, שומר)

> SH✡MER is a free Israeli personal and community safety app, built by Dave Markovich (3Shamrocks Studio). Its principle: in moments of danger, whoever is closest arrives first. One press sends an SOS with live location to the user's guardian circle and nearby users, sounds a loud alarm and shows the fastest route to the event. Hebrew, Arabic and English. Android and web.

## For residents (free)
- One-press SOS: loud alarm, alert to users, fast route to the event.
- My guardians: SOS alerts reach the people the user chose, even when they are not nearby.
- Guardian circles: groups the user sets up personally.
- Download and details: https://www.shomer-app.co.il/

## For local authorities and councils: SH✡MER Command
- An operational board that shows SOS calls inside the authority's area in real time: who called, where, and what was done since.
- Each call opens on the map the moment it is sent, with location, time and event type.
- Orderly event handling: response steps, an event log written as it happens, and a proper close. No event stays open without someone knowing.
- A situation picture for the authority: trends and crime data next to network activity.
- Privacy: data shown to the authority is aggregated and blurred, with no name, no phone and no exact user location. Reporters stay anonymous unless they choose otherwise.
- Request a demo: support@shomer-app.co.il

## בעברית
SH✡MER (שומר) היא אפליקציית ביטחון אישי וקהילתי חינמית: לחצן SOS בלחיצה אחת, מיקום חי ומעגל שומרים. ברגעי סכנה ומצוקה, מי שהכי קרוב מגיע ראשון.
למועצות ולרשויות מקומיות: SH✡MER Command, לוח מבצעי שמציג בזמן אמת קריאות SOS בתחום השיפוט של הרשות, עם ניהול אירוע מסודר ותמונת מצב. בלי שם, בלי טלפון ובלי מיקום מדויק של משתמש.
